title_zh: 豆包工作与飞书 Aily 深度融合，或改为按 Token 用量计费
content_zh:
据界面新闻报道，豆包工作正与飞书 Aily 深度融合，后续可能改为完全按实际 Token 消耗计费，取代当前按席位与 AI 额度组合售卖的方式。多名知情人士预计，新计费方式会显著降低企业的使用成本。

目前，豆包工作支持的模型均来自字节跳动自研的豆包系列。报道称，产品未来还将允许企业客户接入自行采购的第三方大模型 API，并直接与模型厂商结算。界面新闻就上述消息向飞书求证，截至发稿未获回应。
title_en: ByteDance's Doubao Works Integrates with Feishu Aily, Weighs Pay-Per-Token Billing
content_en:
ByteDance's enterprise AI assistant, Doubao Works, is undergoing a deep integration with Feishu Aily, the collaboration platform's AI agent creation tool. According to Jiemian News, the service may transition to a pay-per-token billing model, replacing the current subscription model that bundles user seats with AI quotas. Industry insiders expect this shift to significantly lower operational costs for enterprise clients.

Currently, Doubao Works only supports ByteDance's proprietary Doubao large language models. However, the report suggests that the platform plans to allow enterprise customers to integrate third-party APIs and settle payments directly with external model providers. Feishu has not yet responded to requests for comment.

title_zh: 抖音收紧财经内容治理，三季度处置 4.5 万多条违规内容
content_zh:
抖音昨天公布 2026 年第三季度财经生态治理进展，已处置 4.5 万多条违规内容和 1000 多个违规账号。其中，平台全量下线「理财师」认证，已清退 6888 名认证用户；处置非法荐股内容超 3 万条，违规跨境金融服务营销内容超 1.5 万条。

在抖音此次更新前一天，小红书也发布了首份《社区金融生态公约》，划分了非法荐股等八类禁止内容。小红书称，近半年已处置违规笔记超 101 万篇、违规账号 15.7 万多个和违规评论超 477 万条。
title_en: Douyin and Xiaohongshu Crack Down on Financial Content Violations
content_en:
Douyin has intensified its crackdown on financial content violations, removing over 45,000 pieces of non-compliant content and penalizing more than 1,000 accounts in the third quarter. As part of this campaign, the platform completely discontinued its "Financial Planner" certification, stripping the status from 6,888 verified users. The sweep also targeted over 30,000 posts containing illegal stock recommendations and 15,000 posts promoting unauthorized cross-border financial services.

In a parallel move, social commerce platform Xiaohongshu released its first "Community Financial Ecology Pact," which explicitly bans eight categories of content, including illegal stock recommendations. Xiaohongshu reported that over the past six months, it has removed more than 1.01 million non-compliant posts, suspended 157,000 accounts, and deleted 4.77 million violating comments.

title_zh: 字节跳动分拆 AI 制药业务，Anew Labs 完成 2.9 亿美元融资
content_zh:
据路透社报道，字节跳动分拆的 AI 制药公司 Anew Labs 完成首轮外部融资，规模为 2.9 亿美元，投后估值达 15 亿美元。

本轮由 HSG、IDG 资本和高瓴等机构参与，五源资本联合领投，高榕创投、春华资本、博裕资本、上海未来产业基金及战略投资方 SBP 集团也在投资人名单中。

Anew Labs 总部位于上海，主要用 AI 开发药物。消息人士称，字节跳动在融资后仍持有 56% 股权；该公司认为，AI 制药与字节跳动的核心互联网业务有不同的产业逻辑和管理方式，因此将其独立运营。
title_en: ByteDance Spins Off AI Drug Discovery Unit Anew Labs in $290 Million Funding Round
content_en:
Anew Labs, an AI-driven drug discovery startup spun off from ByteDance, has secured $290 million in its inaugural external funding round, valuing the company at $1.5 billion, according to Reuters.

The funding round was co-led by 5Y Capital, with participation from prominent investors including HSG, IDG Capital, Hillhouse, Gaorong Ventures, Primavera Capital, Boyu Capital, the Shanghai Future Industry Fund, and strategic investor SBP Group. Following the transaction, ByteDance remains the majority shareholder with a 56% stake.

Headquartered in Shanghai, Anew Labs leverages artificial intelligence to accelerate drug development. ByteDance reportedly decided to spin off the unit because the AI biopharma sector operates under a fundamentally different business logic and management structure compared to its core internet operations.

title_zh: Zipline 据报洽谈新融资，估值或升至 200 亿美元
content_zh:
据 The Information 报道，无人机配送公司 Zipline 正在洽谈新一轮融资，目标估值约 200 亿美元。交易仍处于讨论阶段，最终估值和融资安排可能调整。

Zipline 今年 1 月曾宣布完成超过 6 亿美元融资，投后估值为 76 亿美元；若此次交易按目标估值完成，公司的估值将在约 8 个月内增至此前的 2.6 倍。公司当时披露，其商业配送次数已超过 200 万次，并计划将服务扩展至休斯敦、凤凰城及更多美国城市。

Zipline 的业务已从卢旺达等地的医疗物资运输，逐步扩展至美国的食品、零售和医疗用品即时配送。公司表示，其无人机可在约 10 分钟内把商品送至符合条件的用户家中。
title_en: Drone Delivery Pioneer Zipline in Talks for Funding at $20 Billion Valuation
content_en:
Drone delivery company Zipline is reportedly in talks to raise a new round of funding that could propel its valuation to approximately $20 billion, according to a report by *The Information*. The discussions are still in the early stages, meaning the final valuation and funding terms could still change.

This potential funding comes shortly after Zipline announced a funding round of over $600 million in January, which valued the company at $7.6 billion. If the current talks materialize at the targeted $20 billion mark, Zipline's valuation will have surged 2.6 times in just about eight months. At the time of its previous funding, the company revealed it had completed over 2 million commercial deliveries and was planning to expand its services to more U.S. cities, including Houston and Phoenix.

Originally known for delivering medical supplies in countries like Rwanda, Zipline has successfully expanded its footprint into the U.S. market. It now offers instant delivery of food, retail goods, and healthcare products, boasting the capability to deliver items to eligible households within approximately 10 minutes.

title_zh: 💡 扎克伯格反对 AI 行业集体减速，主张独立评估
content_zh:
Meta CEO 马克·扎克伯格 9 月 15 日表示，AI 实验室不需要通过行业协调共同减速。他认为，市场竞争、法律责任和声誉风险已经给各家公司提供了足够的安全激励，更可行的办法是让独立评估机构持续测试前沿模型。

这番表态回应了 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 提出的行业放缓建议。扎克伯格称，Meta 超级智能实验室已经使用第三方评估，并会在发现风险时延后发布；此前公司就以安全为由推迟了 Muse 模型。他同时强调，Meta 的大部分算力仍用于改善现有产品，而非让模型递归式自我升级。

他的分歧重点落在责任主体上。行业集体承诺容易把风险判断交给少数实验室协调，独立评估则允许不同机构用统一方法比较模型能力、可控性和滥用风险，再由监管与市场追究具体公司的责任。

扎克伯格还区分了当前产品研发与模型递归式自我改进。他说，Meta 的大部分算力用于改善用户正在使用的产品；即使公司继续加速研发，前沿模型的发布仍应通过外部评估和内部安全门槛。
title_en: Mark Zuckerberg Opposes Collective AI Slowdown, Advocating for Independent Evaluations
content_en:
Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has voiced his opposition to a coordinated industry-wide slowdown in AI development. Speaking on September 15, Zuckerberg argued that market competition, legal liabilities, and reputational risks already provide sufficient safety incentives for companies. Instead of a collective pause, he advocated for continuous testing of frontier models by independent evaluation organizations.

Zuckerberg's comments serve as a counterpoint to a recent suggestion by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, who proposed an industry-wide slowdown. Zuckerberg revealed that Meta's superintelligence lab already utilizes third-party evaluations and has previously delayed model releases—such as its Muse model—due to safety concerns.

The core of the disagreement lies in accountability. Zuckerberg warned that collective industry commitments risk placing critical safety decisions in the hands of a small cartel of labs. In contrast, independent evaluations would allow different bodies to assess model capabilities, controllability, and abuse risks using standardized methods, leaving regulators and the market to hold individual companies accountable.

Furthermore, the Meta CEO distinguished between standard product development and recursive self-improvement. He emphasized that the majority of Meta's computing power is currently dedicated to enhancing existing consumer products rather than training models to recursively upgrade themselves. Even as Meta accelerates its research and development, Zuckerberg maintained that the release of frontier models must still clear both external evaluations and internal safety thresholds.

title_zh: 5999 元起，豆包手机努比亚 NaviX Ultra 正式发布
content_zh:
努比亚昨天发布 NaviX Ultra，起售价 5999 元，国家补贴后 5499 元起。新机搭载豆包手机助手消费者版，可根据任务自动选择对话或操作模式，通过系统级 Agent 跨多个应用完成搜索、规划、下单等操作。官方称，其端到端任务成功率超过 80%。

语音助手支持十多种方言、连续对话和中途打断；已接入出行、地图、汽水音乐及飞书等服务，后台任务可排队并追加需求。

硬件方面，新机搭载第五代骁龙 8 至尊版、7100mAh 电池和 2 亿像素主摄，并配备独立 AI 按键。
title_en: Nubia Launches NaviX Ultra AI Phone Powered by ByteDance's Doubao Assistant
content_en:
Nubia has officially launched its latest flagship smartphone, the NaviX Ultra, with prices starting at 5,999 RMB (reduced to 5,499 RMB with China's national subsidies). The standout feature of the device is its integration of the consumer version of ByteDance's Doubao Mobile Assistant. Powered by a system-level AI Agent, the phone can automatically switch between dialogue and action modes to complete complex cross-app tasks—such as searching, planning, and placing orders—with an official end-to-end success rate exceeding 80%.

The built-in voice assistant supports over ten Chinese dialects, continuous conversation, and real-time interruption. It is deeply integrated with popular services including ride-hailing, maps, Qishui Music, and Feishu (Lark), allowing users to queue background tasks and append additional requests on the fly.

On the hardware front, the NaviX Ultra is equipped with the flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite processor, a massive 7,100mAh battery, and a 200-megapixel main camera. It also features a dedicated physical AI button for quick access to its smart features.

title_zh: Devin Cloud 接入 macOS，可自主开发和测试 iOS 应用
content_zh:
Cognition 昨天宣布为 Devin Cloud 推出 macOS 工作区，将自主编程流程扩展到 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 原生应用。Devin 现在可以在云端使用 Xcode 和 iOS Simulator，从复现问题、修改代码，一直运行到应用内验证。

该工作区基于 AWS EC2 Mac 裸金属主机和苹果 Virtualization.framework 运行。Cognition 为虚拟机加入持久化快照、网络访问规则，并在任务开始前完成 Xcode 安装、Simulator 预热与系统索引。

为测试原生应用，Devin 可同时读取辅助功能树与屏幕截图，用结构化控件完成按钮操作，再检查界面和状态变化。用户可在 VNC 和独立的 iOS Simulator 面板查看运行结果，并随时接管操作。
title_en: Devin Cloud Integrates macOS to Autonomously Develop and Test iOS Apps
content_en:
Cognition has announced the launch of a macOS workspace for Devin Cloud, expanding its autonomous coding capabilities to native iPhone, iPad, and Mac applications. Devin can now utilize Xcode and the iOS Simulator in the cloud to handle tasks ranging from bug replication and code modification to in-app verification.

The workspace is built on AWS EC2 Mac bare-metal instances and Apple's Virtualization.framework. To optimize performance, Cognition has integrated persistent snapshots and network access rules, while pre-installing Xcode, warming up the Simulator, and indexing the system before tasks begin.

For native app testing, Devin analyzes accessibility trees alongside screenshots, interacts with UI elements like buttons, and monitors interface and state changes. Users can monitor progress in real-time via VNC or a standalone iOS Simulator panel, with the option to take control at any moment.

title_zh: 野人先生回应罗永浩吐槽：会听取顾客意见
content_zh:
野人先生昨天回应罗永浩对产品口味和价格的吐槽，称会听取顾客意见，继续改进产品。罗永浩 9 月 12 日在微博发文称，在机场试吃野人先生后觉得口味「很一般」，并对其价格提出质疑。

野人先生创立于 2011 年，主打现制 Gelato。截至 2025 年 8 月，其门店数量已达 1000 家，主力产品价格为 28 元和 38 元。创始人崔渐为曾称，品牌毛利率约为 60%，价格主要受应季水果等原料成本影响。
title_en: Gelato Brand Mr. Yeren Responds to Tech Influencer Luo Yonghao's Criticism
content_en:
Chinese gelato brand Mr. Yeren has responded to criticism from high-profile tech influencer Luo Yonghao regarding its taste and pricing, stating that the company values customer feedback and will continue to improve its products. The response follows a Weibo post by Luo on September 12, in which he described the gelato he sampled at an airport as "very average" and questioned its high price.

Founded in 2011, Mr. Yeren specializes in freshly made gelato and has expanded rapidly, boasting 1,000 stores as of August 2025. Its signature products are priced between 28 and 38 RMB. According to founder Cui Jianwei, the brand maintains a gross margin of around 60%, with pricing heavily influenced by the cost of premium ingredients like seasonal fruits.

title_zh: 钟薛高宣布降价重启，首批雪糕 6.9 元起
content_zh:
钟薛高昨天宣布品牌重启，新运营主体为钟雪高品牌管理（上海）有限公司。首批轻牛乳、丝绒可可和半半巧巧 3 款产品预计今年第四季度上市，建议零售价分别为 6.9 元和 7.9 元一支。

首批产品将延续标志性瓦片造型，规格、克重、配方和配料表均与过去保持一致。新公司现阶段采用委托生产模式，由曾为钟薛高生产的代工厂承接。

钟薛高方面表示，降价是对消费者期待的回应，原材料、物流等客观条件也已发生变化。食品科普博主陈大成出任新公司 CEO，负责品牌独立运营。
title_en: Ice Cream Brand Zhongxuegao Relaunches with Lower Prices Starting at 6.9 Yuan
content_en:
Chinese ice cream brand Zhongxuegao, once dubbed the "Hermès of ice cream," has announced a brand relaunch under a new operating entity, Zhongxuegao Brand Management (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. The first batch of three classic flavors—Light Milk, Velvet Cocoa, and Banban Qiaoqiao—is scheduled to hit the market in the fourth quarter of this year, with suggested retail prices slashed to 6.9 yuan and 7.9 yuan.

The upcoming products will retain their signature Chinese tile-shaped design, with the same specifications, weight, and original recipes. For this relaunch, the new company is adopting an outsourced manufacturing model, partnering with the OEM factories that previously produced for the brand.

According to Zhongxuegao, the price reduction is a direct response to consumer expectations, aided by shifts in raw material and logistics costs. Food science blogger Chen Dacheng has been appointed as the CEO of the new entity to lead its independent operations.
